title: WEB-1: Deploy `site` as a Worker on a preview URL behind Cloudflare Access, `noindex`
body:
**Owner:** Ops
**Trigger:** GH-2
**Done check:** Preview returns 200 for Rowan, 403 for anyone else
**Status:** closed

Source of truth: `docs/roadmap.md` (item WEB-1). Every closed item proposes a plus: file it as a new issue labeled `plus`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 273.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
